events.summary: MapThis update allows you to have a map and view room activities.The map currently displays:1. Save points2. Item Boxes3. Notes4. Computers5. DoorsRooms are categorized into four types:1. Unseen – the player is unaware of them and has not visited them.2. Unknown – blacked-out rooms; these appear if there is an adjacent door the player has not yet entered. In some cases, they are not shown even near the door to maintain suspense.3. events.title: Update 0.1.3 - Fixes & Players Notes
events.summary: Player NoteYou can now find a pencil and a note; combining them allows you to write any message. When you pin the note to a wall, its data is sent to the server, enabling it to receive likes.These likes will appear in your leaderboard statistics.Server NotesA leaderboard button has been added to the main menu; it appears when you are logged into Steam and have access to the game server.Your position on the global leaderboard depends on the likes your notes receive, so post useful or funny notes

events.title: Update 0.1.3 - Item Boxes, Crafts, New Riddles
events.summary: ChestsSave Rooms now contain chests, which hold a 4x4 amount of items.
